title: Alone Together
reception: Opened Friday, Oct 16, 2026, with live music
description: New work by Julie Lindell, Bix Lye and Paulien Lethen. The opening on Friday, Oct 16 had live music by Duo Laroo/Byrd: Saskia Laroo (trumpet, saxophone, bass, vocals) and Warren Byrd (piano, vocals, bongos).
